description.value:
You gain one of the following features of your choice.

  • Pack Tactics. You have Advantage on Attack Rolls with your natural weapons against a creature if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't Incapacitated.
  • A Friend in Deed. You can take the Help action as a Bonus Action and with a range of 30 feet. You can always use the Help action to give someone Advantage on a skill check, even if you are not proficient in the relevant skill yourself.
  • Thick Hide. The temporary hit points gained through your Martial Mastery (Unarmored Defense) increase by half (rounded down). Additionally, you have Advantage on Saving Throws against becoming Poisoned or Lacerated.
